transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Well, what finally got me to come in here today is that... over the past few months, my mind just keeps jumping all over the place. 

I drive a truck for a living, and lately, it feels like every little CB radio chirp, every fuel price sign on the highway, or just some new idea popping into my head completely distracts me. Because of it, I'm missing details that I normally never miss. You know, things like a client’s delivery note, or forgetting who I promised to call back. It's starting to mess with my work, so I figured I needed to talk to somebody about it.
Growing up, did you ever have trouble with focus or attention in school, or is this completely new for you?

No, this is pretty new. I mean, I wasn't exactly the star student or anything back in the day, but I never had trouble paying attention like this. I could always focus on what I needed to get done. This whole feeling of my brain just... bouncing around everywhere, that really just started up over the last few months.
Have you noticed that you need significantly less sleep than usual while still feeling full of energy?

Yeah, actually, I have. Most nights lately, I'm sleeping maybe... three or four hours tops. Then I'm just up, way before daylight. And the weird thing is, instead of feeling worn out from not sleeping much, I feel completely wide awake and ready to roll.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life where you felt down, depressed, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I have days where I'm just tired or maybe a little grumpy, like anybody else, but... nothing like what you're describing. I've never really felt down for a long stretch or lost interest in my hobbies or anything like that. I've always been pretty even-keeled until all this started happening recently.
Has this restlessness and distraction gotten so severe that it has completely disrupted your ability to do your job or caused major trouble at work?

Well, it hasn't completely stopped me from working, but... it's definitely causing some issues. I drive a truck and handle sales, and lately, I've had to ask dispatch and some of my clients to repeat details that I normally would have just remembered. And, uh, a couple of my sales follow-ups slipped through the cracks because I was just... chasing too many ideas at once. 

It's affecting things at home, too. My wife and daughter, they've been kind of walking on eggshells around me. I can tell I'm just adding strain to the house when I'm supposed to be the one helping out. So, yeah, it's definitely getting in the way.
Have you ever been hospitalized or needed urgent medical care because of these symptoms?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've never had to go to the hospital or the ER or anything like that for this. It's just been me dealing with it, and my family noticing it. But no, no urgent care or hospitals.
During this time, have you heard or seen things that others couldn't, or felt like people were watching you or out to get you?

No, nothing like that. I haven't heard voices or seen things that aren't there. And I don't feel like anyone is out to get me or watching me, no. It's just... mostly just the racing thoughts and the energy I mentioned. But my mind isn't playing tricks on me like that.
